name: llm-self-evaluation-diagnostics
description: Complete diagnostic evaluation package for LLM self-evaluation reliability. Includes Math-360 (controlled diagnostic testbed), processed cross-domain category splits, prompts, reference labels from a three-judge LLM ensemble, released model outputs, and diagnostic metric code.
rai:dataCollection: Math-360 questions authored by the paper's authors. Cross-domain metadata derived from public datasets (TruthfulQA, CommonsenseQA, MATH-500) under their respective licenses; original question text is not redistributed here. Reference labels generated from a three-judge LLM ensemble.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Three independent LLM judges (Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Amazon Nova Premier, DeepSeek-R1) return pairwise preferences with reference-answer access; majority vote is the reference preference. Invalid responses (<0.4%) are excluded.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Stratified sampling per category for TruthfulQA / CommonsenseQA (10 categories × 24 questions = 240 per testbed). Category mappings released without original question text.
rai:dataUseCases: Diagnosing whether LLM-reported confidence is reliable enough for confidence-gated downstream decisions; comparing models under a fixed reference signal.
rai:dataLimitations: LLM-judge reference is a fixed comparative signal, not oracle ground truth. Controlled testbed size (360 items) is not a general-purpose leaderboard. Proprietary judge outputs may drift with vendor updates.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Intended to support responsible evaluation of confidence-gated LLM decisions. Should not be used to certify deployment safety or as a general-purpose leaderboard.

recordSet.name: math360-records
recordSet.description: Math-360 original problems used as the controlled diagnostic testbed.

recordSet.description: Per-pair reference labels (majority vote across three LLM judges) and the target model's self-selection and confidence.
